newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound/dlr rates marginally down.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound/dlr rates marginally down.

text.p: The Egyptian pound fell slightly against the dollar in the private sector market on Wednesday, bankers said.
Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3930 and 3.3948 pounds bid and 3.3935 and 3.3970 pounds offered in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3939 pounds bid and 3.3956 pounds offered. The averages compared with 3.3935 pounds bid and 3.3951 pounds offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.390764 buy and 3.393253 sell.
